name: Modules.Nfc.TagTechnology
summary: Represents an interface to a specific tag technology.
description:
NFC tags are based on a number of independently developed technologies and offer a wide range of
capabilities. The TagTechnology proxies provide access to these different technologies and capabilities.
The TagTechnology proxy is the base type for more type-specific tag technologies. You will
work with the type-specific tag technology proxies which provide capabilities for each tag technology.

Use one of the [Modules.Nfc.createTagTechnologyIsoDep](api:Modules.Nfc#createTagTechnologyIsoDep), [Modules.Nfc.createTagTechnologyMifareClassic](api:Modules.Nfc#createTagTechnologyMifareClassic),
[Modules.Nfc.createTagTechnologyMifareUltralight](api:Modules.Nfc#createTagTechnologyMifareUltralight), [Modules.Nfc.createTagTechnologyNdefFormatable](api:Modules.Nfc#createTagTechnologyNdefFormatable),
[Modules.Nfc.createTagTechnologyNdef](api:Modules.Nfc#createTagTechnologyNdef), [Modules.Nfc.createTagTechnologyNfcA](api:Modules.Nfc#createTagTechnologyNfcA),
[Modules.Nfc.createTagTechnologyNfcB](api:Modules.Nfc#createTagTechnologyNfcB), [Modules.Nfc.createTagTechnologyNfcF](api:Modules.Nfc#createTagTechnologyNfcF), [Modules.Nfc.createTagTechnologyNfcV](api:Modules.Nfc#createTagTechnologyNfcV)
method variants to create a tag technology proxy.

See also:
[TagTechnology](http://developer.android.com/reference/android/nfc/tech/TagTechnology.html)

examples.title: Write Ndef Tag

properties.name: tag
properties.summary: The tag technology that has been discovered.
properties.description:
When a tag is discovered, a [Modules.Nfc.NfcTag](api:Modules.Nfc.NfcTag) proxy is created and passed as a property to the `onNdefDiscovered`, `onTagDiscovered`, or
`onTechDiscovered` callback (see [NdefDiscovered](api:NdefDiscovered)).

methods.name: close
methods.summary: Disable I/O operations to the tag and release resources.

methods.name: connect
methods.summary: Enable I/O operations to the tag.
methods.description: Only one Tag Technology proxy can be connected to a Tag at a time.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.summary: Returns true if connect has completed, and close has not been called, and the tag is not known to be out of range.

methods.name: isValid
methods.summary: Return true if this tag technology was successfully obtained.
